evidence.ACL: Mild laxity contour of ACL and PCL with increase signal intensity inside, R/O grade 1-2 injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of lateral meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular cartilage and subchondral bone marrow edema and sclerosis of medial femoral condyle and spur formation, reflecting osteoarthritis.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
evidence.Contusion: subchondral bone marrow edema and sclerosis of medial femoral condyle and spur formation, reflecting osteoarthritis.
